description: Information about the resource record set to create or delete.

Name.description: The name of the domain for the resource record set.

SetIdentifier.description: An identifier that differentiates among multiple resource record sets that have the same combination of name and type.

Weight.description: The weight for weighted routing, ranging from 0 to 255.

Region.description: The Amazon EC2 region for latency-based routing.

TTL.description: The resource record cache time to live (TTL), in seconds.

Value.description: The current or new DNS record value.

HostedZoneId.description: The hosted zone ID for the alias target.

DNSName.description: The DNS domain name for the alias target.

EvaluateTargetHealth.description: Whether Route 53 responds to DNS queries using this alias by checking the health of the alias target.

HealthCheckId.description: The ID of the health check to associate with the record set.

name: ResourceRecordSet
